NIVIN S JOHN
Tech Lead • Bengaluru, India • 📞 +91 99461 65475 • ✉ getnivinjohn@gmail.com
raw_sections.skills:
CORE SKILLS
 Backend: Java (8–17), Spring Boot, Microservices, REST, GraphQL, Reactive Programming (Reactor, CompletableFuture), Multithreading & Concurrency, Caching (Redis, Hazelcast)
 Cloud & DevOps: OCI, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, API Gateway, Lambda), Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Helm (familiar), CI/CD pipelines
 Databases & Messaging: Oracle, PostgreSQL, Sybase, Kafka
 System Design: Distributed Systems, Scalability, Event-Driven Architecture, API Gateway, Fault Tolerance (Resilience4j/Hystrix), Rate Limiting, High Availability
 Security: JWT, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML2, API Security, Encryption
 Testing & Quality: JUnit, Mockito, Integration Testing, Contract Testing, JMeter (perf), CI/CD validation
 Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, JMX/Jolokia, Kibana
 Leadership: Mentoring, Team leadership (2 engineers), Code reviews, Feature ownership
 AI/GenAI: LLM Integrations, Autogen, Oracle LLM services, Prompt Engineering, Agentic PoCs
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Oracle India Pvt. Ltd. — Senior Software Engineer
Bengaluru, India | Aug 2021 – Present
 Designed Apex on RI framework with Spring Cloud Gateway, JWT, tunneling → reduced CRUD app delivery effort by ~60%.
 Upgraded OIC Adapter (Gen2 → Gen3), adding multi-auth & integrations; migrated customers with zero downtime.
 Modernized microservices (Java 7→17, Spring Security OAuth2/SAML2) → +20% perf, -35% vulnerabilities.
 Led 2 engineers on Spring Boot upgrade; mentored intern who secured PPO.  Integrated observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) + load testing (JMeter).
 GenAI projects: Reply Box Agent (Hackathon winner), Intelligent Campaign Designer (released), Review Analyzer (customer insights), Marketing Automation Agents (PoC).
MDSap Tech SA — Senior Software Engineer
Abu Dhabi, UAE | Jan 2019 – Jul 2021
 Built omni-channel banking/healthcare apps with Spring Boot, SAPUI5/OpenUI5, OData, Angular, Oracle DB, Sybase.
 Developed responsive SPAs (OpenUI5/Angular 9+Material) → 25% faster load times.
 Implemented REST APIs & security filters/interceptors for high-traffic financial systems.
 Optimized SQL queries, supported Sybase→Oracle migration, improving daily ops efficiency.  Created Angular+XSJS portal for HANA team → reduced manual processes by 20%.
IBS Software — Software Engineer → Senior Software Engineer
Trivandrum, India | May 2015 – Dec 2018
 Enhanced airline seat management algorithms → 40% efficiency boost.  Automated flight data ingestion with Spring Batch pipelines.
 Built productivity tools: I-Build (ClearCase automation), Roster Mgmt tool, saving hours per release.  Maintained production configs for multiple airline clients using SVN & ClearCase.
 Mentored juniors; represented IBS at Vistara Aviation Hackathon Finals (2017).
PROJECTS & GENAI
Reply Box Agent (Hackathon Winner)
Email orchestration with Autogen + Spring Boot; conversation-aware replies.
Impact: 1st place, added to roadmap.
Intelligent Campaign Designer
AI side-panel for scoring, prediction, content generation.
Impact: Released to customers.
Review Analyzer
Summarization + sentiment analysis of feedback → dashboards.
Impact: Helped sales reduce churn risk.
Marketing Automation Agents (PoC)
Built 4 agents for campaign creation/event mgmt with Spring Boot + Python.
Impact: Demoed to leadership, under productization.
